reviews.scopeMarkdown:
**Số từ bài gốc: 191 từ**, đếm trên nguyên văn bằng cách tách theo khoảng trắng; đạt yêu cầu 150–200 từ của lớp.
Phạm vi: Cô chấm Đề 1 đã gõ; chưa chấm Đề 2 hoặc bản scan.
reviews.overall: Bài này em cần sửa và nộp lại. Cụm “female politicians” ở đầu Overview và Detail 2 chưa nêu đầy đủ đối tượng nữ nghị sĩ theo yêu cầu bài học. Overview còn thiếu mức tăng nổi bật của United Kingdom và việc nước này bằng Belgium vào cuối kỳ. Em đã chia đủ năm nước, đưa số liệu lên đầu Detail 1, dùng quy chiếu và chọn đúng đỉnh France năm 2004. Cô giữ những phần đó. Em cần vận dụng lại yêu cầu về đại lượng và đặc điểm chính để tự sửa hai câu được đánh dấu, rồi nộp lại bài đủ bốn đoạn.
reviews.dataGrouping: Em đưa Germany–Italy vào Detail 1 và France–United Kingdom–Belgium vào Detail 2. Cách nhóm này có cơ sở theo thứ hạng cuối kỳ: hai nước ở đoạn trước có tỷ lệ phần trăm cao hơn ba nước ở đoạn sau vào năm 2012. Cô giữ cả nhóm và thứ tự của em; đỉnh France năm 2004 vẫn cần được nêu rõ vì nước này đứng đầu tại mốc đó. “Regarding the remaining countries” nối đúng với ba nước chưa trình bày.

reviews.originalEssay:
The given line chart illustrates the proportion of female members of parliament in five European countries over a 12-year period, commencing from 2000.

Overall, almost all surveyed nations witnessed an upward trend in the percentage of female politicians. Despite this, Germany and Italy maintained the highest figures throughout most of the period, while the UK started with the lowest proportion.

To elaborate, in 2000, around 33% of parliament members in Germany were women. This number remained relatively stable and increased slightly to nearly 37% in 2012. The figures for Italy, conversely, went up steadily from roughly 26% to 39%, thereby allowing this nation to overtake Germany and become the highest in the final year.

Regarding the remaining countries, the proportion of female politicians in France fluctuated, rising from 25% in 2000 to a peak of 37% in 2004 before falling to 31% in 2012. The most noticeable upturn was seen in the UK, rising sharply from only about 3% in 2000 to 28% in 2012. The data for Belgium also grew from around 17% in 2000 to nearly 28% in 2004, yet it remained flat until the end of the period.

reviews.originalEssay:
The given pie charts illustrate the main reasons why students chose a particular university in the UK over a 10-year period, commencing from 1997.

Overall, suitable degree courses remained the most popular factor in both years. Despite this, proximity to parental home witnessed the most significant increase, whereas good sports and social activities saw a dramatic decline.

To elaborate, in 1997, a major 35% of students chose a university because of suitable degree courses. This number went up slightly to 37% in 2007, thereby allowing this factor to maintain its leading position throughout the whole timeline. The figures for quality of resources, conversely, dropped from 21% to 17% after ten years.

Regarding the remaining reasons, the most noticeable upturn was seen in proximity to parental home, rising from 10% in 1997 to 22% in 2007. Similarly, the percentage of students choosing a university due to quality of teaching grew moderately from 15% to 18%. In contrast, the figure for good sports and social activities dropped significantly from 19% to only 6%, yet it remained an option for a small proportion of students in the final studied year.

Tuy nhiên, mở bài và một số câu chi tiết nói chung về mức hài lòng, trong khi bảng chỉ đếm tỷ lệ sinh viên chọn mức “very good”; em cần giữ đúng đại lượng này xuyên suốt bài. Overview của em nêu Commerce cao ở “most categories”, nhưng thực ra Commerce cao nhất hoặc đồng hạng cao nhất ở cả năm hạng mục. Câu cuối ghép 81% của Commerce và 80% của Law vào cùng một mức cao nhất, đồng thời bỏ mất 60% của Economics. Em sửa các điểm đó và soát dấu chấm cuối bài.
reviews.dataGrouping: Em chia Detail 1 cho thông tin trước khóa học và giảng dạy, Detail 2 cho ba hạng mục còn lại; cách nhóm theo hạng mục này giúp so sánh ba môn trực tiếp. Em đã nối sang Detail 2 bằng “Regarding the remaining categories” đúng quan hệ. Ở hạng mục Other resources, cần đối chiếu cả Economics để làm rõ khoảng cách 60% so với 80–81%.

reviews.originalEssay:
The given table illustrates how first-year students rated different resources provided by a college for three subjects: Economics, Law, and Commerce.

Overall, students in Commerce gave higher satisfaction ratings for most categories, while those in Law were less satisfied with teaching. Also of note is that Teaching received very high ratings in both Economics and Commerce.

To elaborate, an impressive 95% of Commerce students gave a 'very good' rating to Pre-course information, while only 59% and 72% of Economics and Law students did the same. A similar pattern was true for teaching: Commerce and Economics students found this service the most satisfying (95% each), but the figure for Law was only 62%.

Regarding the remaining categories, while 90% of Economics students were happy with Tutor support, only 76% of Law students did the same, compared to 93% in Commerce. Resources (print) seemed to satisfy around 70% to 85% of students across all three subjects, with the data for Other resources reaching its highest point in Commerce at 81% and Law at 80%

The given table illustrates how five different countries differed in the number of top 200 universities in 2011 for three subjects: Biology, Medicine, and Psychology.    

   Overall, the USA had the highest number of top-ranked universities in all three subjects, followed by the United Kingdom. Also of note is that New Zealand recorded the lowest figures across all categories.   

    To elaborate, an impressive 69 universities in the USA were ranked in the top 200 for Biology, while only 30 in the UK and 9 in both Australia and Canada did the same. A different pattern was true for New Zealand, which had the lowest figure at only 6. 

  Regarding the remaining categories, for Medicine, the USA led with 54 top universities, compared to 24 in the UK, 13 in Australia, 12 in Canada, and only 2 in New Zealand. A similar trend was recorded in Psychology, where the USA had the highest figure at 58, while the UK had 29. The data for the other countries was much lower, with Australia, Canada, and New Zealand having 17, 14, and 4 top universities respectively.

To elaborate, an impressive 69 universities in the USA were ranked in the top 200 for Biology, while only 30 in the UK and 9 in both Australia and Canada did the same. A different pattern was true for New Zealand, which had the lowest figure at only 6.

Regarding the remaining categories, for Medicine, the USA led with 54 top universities, compared to 24 in the UK, 13 in Australia, 12 in Canada, and only 2 in New Zealand. A similar trend was recorded in Psychology, where the USA had the highest figure at 58, while the UK had 29. The data for the other countries was much lower, with Australia, Canada, and New Zealand having 17, 14, and 4 top universities respectively.
